# Mindslice knowledge

For work in this application repository, follow
.claude/skills/mindslice-knowledge/SKILL.md. Read the relevant selected
knowledge before changing application behavior and maintain the shared
knowledge base when the change warrants it. Use its templates only for
approved pages in the canonical knowledge base; prefer the read-only
`mindslice knowledge tree|search|read` commands for access. Do not create duplicate
application-local documentation or edit generated context.

Report missing or inaccessible context; do not assume the service or the
knowledge-base working copy is available in this environment.
